quality_gate.numeric_promotion_policy: Measured promotion still requires direct parse/readback from an authoritative official facility-level annual numeric dataset. The EEA July 2026 listing/distribution identity remains verified but its actual facility-level asset remains unresolved, therefore Lynemouth values remain candidate-only.
quality_gate.candidate_confidence_rule: 99 requires a distinct official installation identity plus target-period operator/site continuity and a uniquely attributable EUTL annual series.
quality_gate.lynemouth_resolution: The previous ambiguity with Lynemouth smelter is closed because official UK ETS NIMS/ICE material identifies Lynemouth Power Limited / Lynemouth Power Station as a distinct installation (UK-E-IN-12774); Environment Agency permits and Companies House preserve the same power-station legal/site chain, while Power-Station-Dictionary uniquely links the power-station object to EUTL account 96827 and target-year verified-emission series.
